title: AblePath M7 scenario realization record (V1, experimental only)
description: Reproducibility record for a deterministic realization drawn from probabilistic damage/debris models. It exists so experiments are reproducible without pretending probabilistic outputs are observations. It is experimental_only=true and production_eligible=false by construction.

seed.description: Pinned seed. An unseeded realization is rejected; null is not permitted.

random_generator.description: Named, versioned generator (e.g. numpy.random.PCG64) so the draw is reproducible.

human_freeze_id.description: null until a human freeze exists. Only a non-null human_freeze_id permits a damage/debris evidence record derived from this realization to be considered for core mapping, and even then production_eligible stays false at this contract version.

m7_eligibility.experimental_only=true: never production eligible at this contract version
m7_eligibility.human_freeze_id=null: no derived record may be mapped to the M7 core
m7_eligibility.human_freeze_id!=null: derived damage/debris records may be considered for core mapping only under a separate frozen contract; this record alone never authorises it

prohibited_derivations: running real-edge production M7 from this contract
presenting a realization as an observation
promoting a realization while human_freeze_id is null
setting production_eligible=true at this contract version
calling calculate_residual_width from the disabled adapter
adapter_rules: the adapter may build an experimental/reference input object only
the adapter must refuse to call calculate_residual_width
synthetic fixtures only; output labelled NON_REAL / EXPERIMENTAL
